        self.events = []
        self.executed = []

        self.executed.append(test.id())
        super().startTest(test)

        self.events.append({"kind": kind, "test_id": test.id(),
                            "parent_test_id": (parent if parent is not None else test).id(),

        super().addError(test, error)
